test_title: PYST 48: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Against the clock

options.text: Running faster with a clock in hand
In a great hurry, as fast as possible

solution:
The solution is **In a great hurry, as fast as possible.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom 'Against the clock' is In a great hurry, as fast as possible.
 
• Therefore **option 2 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss about *idioms:*

 
 
• ​A group of words established by usage as having a meaning not deducible from those of the individual words 
 
• For example:- 
 
 
• Get your act together - Get organized and do things effectively.
 
• Back against the wall - Stuck in a difficult circumstance with no escape.
 
• On cloud nine - Being very happy.
